1: Yahood, Nasara aur mushrikeen mein se jin logon ne kufr kiya, woh kufr par apna ittifaq aur ijtima chhorne wale na thay, yahan tak ke un ke paas ek wazeh daleel aur khuli nishani aa jaye.
2: Yeh wazeh daleel aur khuli nishani Allah ki taraf se ek Rasool hain, jinhein us ne bheja, aur jo paak sahife parhte hain, jinhein sirf sab se paak hastiyan hi chhoo sakti hain.
3: Un sahifon mein sachchi khabrein aur insaaf par mabni ahkaam hain, jo logon ko us cheez ki taraf hidayat dete hain jis mein un ki durustagi aur bhalai hai.
4: Yahood, jinhein Taurat di gayi, aur Nasara, jinhein Injeel di gayi, un mein ikhtilaf nahin hua, siwaye us ke baad ke Allah ne un ki taraf apna Nabi ﷺ bheja. Un mein se kuch Musalman ho gaye, aur kuch apne Nabi ki sachchai jaanne ke bawajood apne kufr par qayam rahe.
5: Yahood aur Nasara ka jurm aur un ki hath-dharmi zahir hai, kyunke is Quran mein unhein sirf wohi kaam karne ka hukm diya gaya jin ka hukm un ki dono kitabon mein diya gaya tha, yani sirf Allah ki ibadat karna, us ke saath shareek thehrane se bachna, namaz qayam karna aur zakaat dena. Pas jin kaamon ka unhein hukm diya gaya, wohi seedha deen hai, jis mein koi kaji nahin.
6: Beshak Yahood, Nasara aur mushrikeen mein se jin logon ne kufr kiya, woh qayamat ke din jahannum mein daakhil honge, jahan woh hamesha rahenge. Wohi makhlooq mein sab se bad-tar hain, Allah ke saath apne kufr aur us ke Rasool ko jhutlane ki wajah se.
7: Beshak jo log Allah par iman rakhte hain aur neik aamaal karte hain, wohi makhlooq mein sab se behtar hain.
8: Un ke Rubb ke paas un ka ajr aise baag hain jin ke darakhton aur mahlon ke neeche nehrein behti hain, aur jin mein woh hamesha rahenge. Allah un se raazi hai, kyunke woh us par iman laaye aur us ki farmanbardari ki, aur woh bhi us se raazi hain, kyunke us ne unhein apni rehmat di. Yeh rehmat us shaks ko mil sakti hai jo apne Rubb se darta hai, pas us ke hukm ko poora karta hai aur us cheez se bachta hai jis se us ne roka.
